text:
Tara: Quick heads-up 1 1 Glacier Neon Edge team offered a 4-week early preview window for their NeonEdge v1 accelerator. Vendor NDA required; they want a short benchmark matrix + a feedback form at the end. Who can own infra + bench? cc @Ben @Hiro :wave:

Ben: I can pick up harness wiring. Need the vendor image and any kernel/firmware pins. Which model sizes do we prioritize? 8B low-latency and 32B medium-context ok?

Hiro: 8B for p50/p90 latency, 32B for 16k context throughput. Also capture cold-start vs warmed KV-cache. Primary metrics: p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, mem high-water, power-avg and peak. Target: draft numbers by 2024-04-17 for an embargoed partner review.

Legal: NDA note 1 vendor NDA permits internal evaluation only. No public benchmarks or marketing without Glacier sign-off. I'll add the embargo checklist to the repo and require 72h partner review for any external figures.

Glacier-Rep: Hi team 1 happy to share images, SSH creds, and a sample telemetry schema. We'll provide per-step power CSVs (ISO timestamps) and an API token for optional telemetry POSTs. We prefer coordinated press if results look good.

Ben: Great. I'll stub the harness repo: https://git.redwood/integration/glacier-neon and add a basic run script. Smoke command I'll use:
```
ssh neon@host
sudo ./run_bench.sh --model redwood/32b-16k --seq 16384 --warm 200 --iter 300
```

Bench-Bot: artifact uploaded: neonedge-v1-20240403.img (17.9G) to s3://glacier-neon/artifacts/ and triggered image-validate job #6312.

Hiro: Telemetry plan: we will ingest power CSVs to S3 and also POST JSON spans for KV cache and per-token latency to Glacier's ingest endpoint for parity. Example envs:
```
export GLACIER_TELEM=https://telemetry.glacier/api/ingest
export REDWOOD_KEY=redwood-gl-neon-xxxx
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d @payload.json $GLACIER_TELEM
```

Glacier-Rep: We'll send tokens, sample payloads, and the feedback form by EOD. We can also run a paired smoke session and stream console logs.

Ben: Minor ops ask  can Glacier include recommended driver+firmware versions in the onboarding doc? That helps reproducibility.

Glacier-Rep: Yes, we'll include recommended driver/firmware combos and an AMI/OCI packaging note for marketplace readiness.

Tara: Let's sync Fri 10:00 PT. Agenda: access creds, telemetry schema, run matrix, embargo checklist, marketplace packaging notes. Add pre-reads to the repo and flag anything embargoed. :calendar:

Ben: Slot works. I'll upload the harness sketch and initial run logs.

Hiro: I'll prepare eval sets and reproducibility scripts (kernel, drivers, firmware, /proc/cmdline capture).

Legal: I'll post the NDA checklist and embargo steps to the integration repo and mark restricted access. Remember: 72h approval required for any external material.

Glacier-Rep: Confirmed for Fri. Looking forward to working with you all. :rocket:
